About.title: About
About.lead: A certified public accountant (CPA) and tax advisor who combines local expertise with global insights to deliver value-driven accounting solutions in Portugal. We stay ahead of regulatory changes and market trends, supporting clients’ financial success in the Portuguese market and beyond. As a strategic partner for your accounting needs in Portugal, Miri offers multilingual communication and culturally nuanced advice—bridging Portuguese fiscal requirements and international best practices. Whether you are an expat managing personal finances or a business expanding into Portugal, we guide you through every step of your financial journey.

ServicesInternational.academicBody: As an accounting professor, I bring cutting-edge knowledge and research-backed strategies to every client engagement. My academic background keeps me at the forefront of international accounting practices and emerging financial regulations.
ServicesInternational.clientLead: My mission is to optimize your financial processes and drive success through:
clientBullets: Customized solutions aligned with your business goals
Proactive risk management and compliance strategies
Clear communication of complex financial concepts
Continuous support throughout your financial journey
ServicesInternational.clientClosing: Whether you are a multinational corporation navigating complex reporting requirements or an individual seeking expert tax advice, I am committed to delivering exceptional value and clarity in international finance. Contact me to explore how expertise in international accounting, IFRS, US-GAAP, and global tax strategies can elevate your operations and ensure compliance across borders.
